# Wiley

> Wiley is a global publisher providing scholarly journals, books, research platforms, and educational content across academic, corporate, and healthcare sectors.

Wiley serves researchers, educators, institutions, and organizations through its Online Library, peer-review platforms like Research Exchange, and AI-powered research tools. The company supports academic societies, publishers, libraries, and corporate R&D teams while advancing open-access publishing and women in research initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Wiley Online Library
- Journal Publishing
- Peer Review
- Open Access
- Research Exchange
- Academic Publishing
- Book Publishing
- Scholarly Resources
- AI Research
- Research Development
- Academic Societies
- Women Researchers
- Textbooks
- Custom Content Solutions
- Research Community

## Publishing for Authors

- [Publish My Work](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish): Central hub for authors to publish journals, books, and articles.
- [Publish Your Book with Expert Guidance](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish/book): Book publishing guidance from manuscript to global distribution.
- [Publish My Article](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish/article): Article submission guidance with Journal Finder and peer-review information.

## Solutions for Institutions & Organizations

- [Academic Libraries](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/academic-institutions/libraries): Library solutions providing journal and book access for institutions.
- [For Societies and Publishers](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers): Publishing solutions for societies and publishers including Research Exchange.
- [Societies](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/societies): Publishing solutions and membership support for academic societies.
- [Research Exchange](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/research-exchange): Research Exchange manuscript management and peer-review platform.
- [For Corporates](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates): Corporate solutions for R&D, marketing, and custom content.
- [AI & Research Development](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates/ai-research-development): Wiley R&D solutions with journals, databases, and AI-powered tools.
- [Hospital and Healthcare](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/hospitals-healthcare): Healthcare resources and clinical content for hospitals and practices.

## Corporate & Marketing Solutions

- [Marketing Solutions](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates/marketing-solutions): B2B marketing solutions using peer-reviewed content.
- [Custom Content Solutions](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/corporates/custom-content-solutions): Custom textbooks and branded content via Wiley Custom Select.
- [Revenue Diversification](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/solutions-partnerships/societies-publishers/revenue-diversification): Strategies for revenue growth through educational and virtual programs.

## Education & Learning Resources

- [Teacher Resources](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/grow/teach-learn/teacher-resources): Textbook and WileyPLUS resources for educators and students.

## Research & Insights

- [ExplanAItions: an artificial intelligence study by Wiley](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/about-us/ai-resources/ai-study): ExplanAItions 2025 AI research study exploring adoption and impact trends.
- [Inspiring Women Researchers](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/research/inspiring-researchers): Stories of women researchers advancing scientific discovery and careers.
- [ANZ research give to gain through knowledge](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/research/inspiring-researchers/anz-research-give-to-gain-through-knowledge): Celebrating women researchers in Australia and New Zealand.

## Optional

- [Back To School Savings and More](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/shop/promotions/bts25): Back to school promotional offer on textbook rentals and eBooks.
